task: Find me a gluten-free diet to lose weight for a pregnant woman.
agent_final_answer:
Based on Healthline, here is a gluten-free eating plan combined with Healthline's guidance on managing weight during pregnancy. Two source articles: "The Gluten-Free Diet: A Beginner's Guide with Meal Plan" (healthline.com/nutrition/gluten-free-diet) and "How to Safely Lose Weight During Pregnancy" (healthline.com/health/pregnancy/how-to-lose-weight-safely).

IMPORTANT MEDICAL CAVEAT (per Healthline):
- A gluten-free diet "should not be considered a weight loss diet"; gluten-free is only medically necessary for people with celiac disease or other gluten-related disorders.
- "Most doctors don't recommend weight loss during pregnancy unless you have significant extra weight." Weight MAINTENANCE is usually safest; actively losing weight is linked to low birth weight. Only attempt managed weight control under a doctor's/dietitian's supervision, and never if your weight is within the healthy CDC range.

CDC pregnancy weight-gain targets by pre-pregnancy BMI:
- Underweight (<18.5): 28-40 lb | Typical (18.5-24.9): 25-35 lb | Overweight (25-29.9): 15-25 lb | Obesity (>=30): 11-20 lb
Calories: ~2,200-2,900/day. Trimester 1: no extra; T2: +340/day; T3: +450/day. Take a daily prenatal vitamin (folate is essential). Exercise 30-60 min/day, 3-5 days/week (walking, swimming, prenatal yoga, jogging).

Healthier-eating tips to control weight gain: eat smaller portions; snack on fruit; more vegetables and fewer starchy sides; swap butter for olive oil; skip condiments; drink water and cut out soda; avoid highly processed snacks (chips, candy).

GLUTEN-FREE 7-DAY SAMPLE MEAL PLAN (naturally gluten-free; use gluten-free-labeled oats/bread/tamari):
- Mon: B-overnight chia pudding w/ Greek yogurt & fruit; L-chicken, lentil & veggie soup; D-steak tacos in gluten-free corn tortillas
- Tue: B-veggie omelet; L-quinoa salad (tomato, cucumber, spinach, avocado); D-shrimp skewers w/ garden salad
- Wed: B-gluten-free oatmeal w/ berries & walnuts; L-tuna salad w/ hard-boiled eggs; D-chicken & broccoli stir-fry w/ gluten-free tamari
- Thu: B-gluten-free toast w/ avocado & egg; L-burrito bowl (black beans, rice, guacamole, fajita veggies); D-garlic butter shrimp w/ side salad
- Fri: B-banana-berry smoothie; L-chicken salad in a gluten-free wrap; D-baked salmon w/ potatoes, broccoli, carrots, green beans
- Sat: B-mushroom & zucchini frittata; L-stuffed bell pepper (ground beef, brown rice, tomato, cheese); D-roasted chicken & quinoa salad
- Sun: B-poached eggs w/ gluten-free bread; L-chicken salad w/ olive oil; D-grilled lamb w/ roasted vegetables

Naturally gluten-free foods to build meals from: meat/fish/poultry, eggs, plain dairy, fruits, vegetables, gluten-free grains (rice, quinoa, buckwheat, corn, millet, gluten-free oats), nuts/seeds, olive/coconut oil. Avoid wheat, barley, rye, spelt and products made from them (bread, pasta, most cereals, baked goods, beer). Always confirm a plan with your doctor or a registered dietitian.
